import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date and time to datetime
df['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'] + ' ' + df['time'])
df['hour'] = df['datetime'].dt.hour
df['day_of_week'] = df['datetime'].dt.day_name()

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Sales by product (top 10)
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10)
bars1 = axes[0, 0].bar(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color=sns.color_palette("husl", len(product_sales)))
axes[0, 0].set_title('Top 10 Products by Total Sales', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
for bar in bars1:
    height = bar.get_height()
    axes[0, 0].text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 5,
                   f'${height:,.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 2. Sales by hour of day
hourly_sales = df.groupby('hour')['total'].sum()
axes[0, 1].plot(hourly_sales.index, hourly_sales.values, marker='o', linewidth=2.5, color='darkorange')
axes[0, 1].fill_between(hourly_sales.index, hourly_sales.values, alpha=0.3, color='darkorange')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Sales by Hour of Day', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2))
axes[0, 1].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 3. Sales by customer age group
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
colors3 = sns.color_palette("Set2", len(age_sales))
wedges, texts, autotexts = axes[0, 2].pie(age_sales.values, labels=age_sales.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                          colors=colors3, startangle=90, textprops={'fontsize': 10})
axes[0, 2].set_title('Sales Distribution by Age Group', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 4. Sales by day of week
day_order = ['Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday', 'Sunday']
day_sales = df.groupby('day_of_week')['total'].sum().reindex(day_order)
bars4 = axes[1, 0].bar(day_sales.index, day_sales.values, color=sns.color_palette("viridis", len(day_sales)))
axes[1, 0].set_title('Sales by Day of Week', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Day of Week', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
for bar in bars4:
    height = bar.get_height()
    axes[1, 0].text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 10,
                   f'${height:,.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 5. Takeaway vs Dine-in sales
takeaway_sales = df.groupby('is_takeaway')['total'].sum()
labels5 = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
colors5 = ['steelblue', 'lightcoral']
wedges5, texts5, autotexts5 = axes[1, 1].pie(takeaway_sales.values, labels=labels5, autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                            colors=colors5, startangle=90, textprops={'fontsize': 10})
axes[1, 1].set_title('Takeaway vs Dine-in Sales', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts5:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 6. Payment method distribution
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
bars6 = axes[1, 2].bar(payment_counts.index, payment_counts.values, color=sns.color_palette("pastel", len(payment_counts)))
axes[1, 2].set_title('Payment Method Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 2].set_xlabel('Payment Method', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 2].set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=12)
for bar in bars6:
    height = bar.get_height()
    axes[1, 2].text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 5,
                   f'{height:,}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# Adjust layout and add overall title
plt.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
